plan.question: Can Sentinel construct a trustworthy current world state, represent actions relative to that world, distinguish observed fact from inference, and prepare for decision-relevant prediction without contaminating authoritative state?

inheritance.rule: Stage 3G reads these; it never rewrites a Stage 3F artifact, certificate, hash, fact, the Decision Evaluation Contract, authority or the expert roster. A Stage 3G result that bears on a frozen fact is reported as new Stage 3G evidence, never as an edit of the fact.

recheck.methodology: the frozen Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM free-action decision-sufficiency method: same eligibility (a zero-cost action is legal and optimal), same candidates (legal zero-cost actions of the symmetric surface), same conditional-logit scorer, optimiser, DEV fit, CAL selection, uniform ties, bootstrap plan and materialGain rule. Only the representation changes. No expert or policy is changed.

new.name: NEW_STAGE3G_OBSERVABLE_REPRESENTATION
new.source: SENTINEL_OBSERVABLE_ENTITY_STATE_V1 + ACTION_SEMANTICS_V1 from the ObservationPacket and the visible map only

D_NEW_PLUS_PRIVILEGED.question: does privileged kernel geometry still add anything once the observable entity state is present?

D_NEW_PLUS_ONE_STEP.question: would a one-step successor prediction add material value on top of the new representation (transition prediction)?

D_NEW_PLUS_HIDDEN_ORIENTATION.question: how much does the hidden generator orientation still buy?

blocks.GEOMETRY: P.1A-SYM deployable: destination vs grid centre/border

metrics.FREE_ACTION_TOP1: expected probability that the chosen zero-cost candidate is oracle-optimal (uniform over tied top scores)
metrics.OPTIMAL_SET_HIT_RATE: softmax probability mass the scorer places on the optimal set, P(optimal set)
metrics.REGRET: expected oracle regret of the choice
metrics.NORMALIZED_REGRET: regret / max regret of the state
metrics.D4_EQUIVARIANCE: NEW feature vectors identical on every D4 twin of the stored equivariance sample, and the selected model's choice maps to the same candidates
metrics.ID_PERMUTATION_INVARIANCE: NEW vectors identical when every entity handle and action id is replaced and the legal list reversed
metrics.CANDIDATE_ORDER_INVARIANCE: the selected model chooses the same candidates when the candidate list is reversed
metrics.OOD: STAGE3G_OOD, curriculum levels 6-7, never used for fitting or selection

recheck.calSelection: the NEW variant with the highest CAL top-1; ties within 1e-9 -> fewer columns

partitions.STAGE3G_HOLDOUT: PRIMARY sealed: 6000 new records, seed 4021, levels 0-5 in canonical order
partitions.STAGE3G_OOD: PRIMARY sealed: 6000 new records, seed 4031, levels 6-7 in canonical order
partitions.P1ASYM_HOLDOUT: SECONDARY replication and binding: the Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM fresh HOLDOUT (seed 2023); OLD must reproduce its certified top-1 exactly; NEW was never scored there
partitions.P1ASYM_OOD: SECONDARY replication and binding: the P.1A-SYM fresh OOD (seed 2033), likewise

thresholds.MATERIAL_RULE: difference >= MATERIAL_TOP1_GAIN, bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and normalised regret not worse (CI lower bound of the nreg difference not > 0): the frozen Stage 3F.6-P.1A-SYM materialGain rule, unchanged
thresholds.GAP_RECOVERY_DEFINITION: (NEW - OLD) / (OLD_PRIVILEGED - OLD) top-1 on the same partition: the share of the Stage 3F privileged-geometry gap the observable representation recovers

conclusionRules.REPRESENTATION_MATERIALLY_IMPROVED: NEW - OLD is MATERIAL on STAGE3G_HOLDOUT and on STAGE3G_OOD, and INTEGRITY holds
conclusionRules.INTEGRITY: NEW feature D4 equivariance = 1, NEW prediction D4 equivariance = 1, identity-renaming invariance = 1, candidate-order invariance = 1, privileged-key scan clean, poisoning probe = 1, E1 effect fidelity = 1, the NEW gain over UNIFORM is positive in every hidden orientation and at least half the overall gain (orientation stability), and D_NEW_PLUS_ABSOLUTE_DIRECTION - NEW is not MATERIAL (no orientation shortcut available to exploit)
conclusionRules.REPRESENTATION_GAP_CLOSED: REPRESENTATION_MATERIALLY_IMPROVED and GAP_RECOVERY >= 0.8 on both partitions and D_NEW_PLUS_PRIVILEGED - NEW not MATERIAL on both and NEW top-1 >= 0.5 on both and NEW MATERIAL vs UNIFORM and vs RESOURCE on both
conclusionRules.REPRESENTATION_GAP_REMAINS: not REPRESENTATION_GAP_CLOSED (some of the Stage 3F gap is still open, whether or not the improvement is material)
conclusionRules.TRANSITION_PREDICTION_NOW_JUSTIFIED: (REPRESENTATION_GAP_CLOSED or REPRESENTATION_GAP_PARTIALLY_CLOSED) and ( D_NEW_PLUS_ONE_STEP - NEW is MATERIAL on both partitions, or the MECHANISTIC + TEMPORAL primary share of NEW residual errors is >= 0.5 on both partitions ). Never true merely because Stage 3G exists.
conclusionRules.POLICY_QUALITY_RESIDUAL: reported: the REPRESENTED_BUT_MISRANKED primary share of NEW residual errors (information present at decision time, ranking failed)

residualTaxonomy.REPRESENTED_BUT_MISRANKED: a single NEW deployable column strictly separates the optimal candidates from the wrongly preferred ones: the information is present and the linear ranking failed (policy quality)
residualTaxonomy.PRIVILEGED_ONLY: no NEW deployable column separates, a privileged kernel relation does (residual representation gap)
residualTaxonomy.MECHANISTIC: only the simulated one-step immediate scalar separates (a one-step transition model could help)
residualTaxonomy.TEMPORAL: nothing above separates and the oracle label is HORIZON_DEPENDENT (multi-step consequences)
residualTaxonomy.INDISTINGUISHABLE: optimal and chosen candidates identical in every view (deployable, privileged, one-step)
residualTaxonomy.weighting: each residual error weighted by 1 - expected hit (uniform ties); multi-label incidence reported alongside

notPermitted: reading any sealed row before the freeze commit

plan.provenance: every Stage 3F declared seed is consumed (D-SYM used the last, 3023/3033); Stage 3G declares a new, disjoint seed space
plan.exclusion: reject any record, world or topology hash claimed by P.1D, T-SYM, P.1A-SYM, P.1-SYM, W-SYM, D-SYM (80,000 rows) or earlier Stage 3G admissions
plan.admission: P.1D benchmark-bound corpusRecord, canonical seed > level > horizon > objectives > roles > shape order; every 25th candidate carries D4 evidence

decisionEvaluationContract.rankingHere: none: no world model is ranked in Stage 3G.1/3G.2

supportForFutureMetrics.FPE: E3 records carry targetTime and the provisional lane resolves them CONFIRMED/REFUTED against later E0 observations: factual prediction error is computable per path
supportForFutureMetrics.CAD: E4 records are per candidate action (source kind COUNTERFACTUAL_MODEL) over ACTION_SEMANTICS_V1 candidates with stable semantic identity: candidate futures can be compared for distinguishability
supportForFutureMetrics.CR: the action-relative state names every legal candidate with its declared cost and deterministic effects; counterfactual regret can be scored on the same candidate sets used here
supportForFutureMetrics.DDV: decisions are made on the observable state; the same eligibility, candidates and sealed partitions give downstream decision value
supportForFutureMetrics.TCA: confidence, verification status and contamination flags are recorded per record, so a trust gate can condition on them

reproducibility.numerics: SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1 (the frozen Stage 3F reproducibility contract): every phase runs through scripts/reproducibility/run-canonical.mjs and the certifier refuses to certify otherwise
reproducibility.reproductions: at least two --check reproductions in the working tree, and a fresh-clone reproduction with the gitignored payloads copied in and verified by manifest content hash
